answers.question: Do trains use a temporary station or platforms during the Turku travel-centre works (the register's platforms sit ~400 m NE of the old station building)? Where do passengers board now?
answers.answer: Passengers board at the Logomo platforms under Logomonsilta (VR address Logomon Silta 1), between Logomonsilta and Aninkaistensilta, about 10–15 min walk from the old station building. Tampere-direction trains moved there on 5 Aug 2024 and all trains (incl. Helsinki–Turku and night trains) on 15 Dec 2024. These are the new permanent passenger-yard platforms, not temporary ones: the yard was completed with tracks 4–6 on 8 Oct 2025, matching the Digitraffic register (L1–L3 valid from 2024-08-05, L4–L6 from 2025-09-29). The old platforms by the station building (2–7) were dismantled in 2022–24 and the old building closed; only car-carrier loading stays there. What is temporary is the station services (waiting area, toilets, café) in Logomo / Logomo Kitchen, until LogoHub opens (est. spring 2027).
answers._source: VR 'Turku' station page, https://www.vr.fi/en/railway-stations-and-routes/turku, read 2026-10-30; VR news 2024-07-26 'Turku railway station to move to Logomo on 5 August 2024', https://www.vr.fi/en/news/2024/07/26/turku-railway-station-to-move-to-logomo-on-5-august-2024, read 2026-10-30; VR news 2024-11-07 'All train traffic will return to Turku railway station on 15 December', https://vr.fi/en/news/2024/11/07/all-train-traffic-will-return-to-turku-railway-station-on-15-december, read 2026-10-30; VR press release 2024-08-02 (STT Info) 'Turun asemapalvelut ja Tampereen suuntaan kulkevien junien lähtölaiturit muuttavat Logomoon 5.8.', https://www.sttinfo.fi/tiedote/70398924/turun-asemapalvelut-ja-tampereen-suuntaan-kulkevien-junien-lahtolaiturit-muuttavat-logomoon-58?lang=fi, read 2026-10-30; Turun Seutusanomat 2025-10-15 'Kupittaa–Turku-ratahanke on valmistunut', https://turunseutusanomat.fi/2025/10/kupittaa-turku-ratahanke-on-valmistunut/, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia 'Turku Central Station', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turku_Central_Station, read 2026-10-30; LogoHub, https://logohub.fi, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit TKU L1–L6 (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0; L1–L3 valid from 2024-08-05, L4–L6 from 2025-09-29), read 2026-10-30
